user.title: Before you start
user.description:
This unofficial integration reads your supplies without changing them.

**For the first connection you need:**
- An API key obtained for an assisted trial.
- Your ENGIE account and any verification code.

The API key is not your ENGIE password or a Home Assistant token. First prepare the connection, then sign in on the ENGIE website and bring the final address back here.

**No API key?** Choose the option below before continuing.

menu_options.api_help: I do not have a key

api_help.title: How to get access
api_help.description:
The API key identifies the connection to ENGIE's service. **It is not your account password**, and this dialog cannot generate it.

**What to do next:**
1. If you are taking part in an assisted trial, ask the person assisting you for the connection configuration.
2. Otherwise check [initial access status and support](https://github.com/GabboPenna/ha-engie-italia/issues/1): there is no verified public procedure for obtaining the key yet.
3. Once you have it, return here and choose **I have a key: continue**.

Without a key, you cannot finish setting up this beta. Never post passwords, verification codes, keys or return addresses in issues.

api_setup.title: 1. Prepare the connection
api_setup.description:
Paste the API key obtained for the assisted trial, then press **Submit**. You will sign in on the ENGIE website in the next step.

**No API key?** Close this dialog, reopen ENGIE Italia from Add integration and choose **I do not have a key**. Do not try account passwords or Home Assistant tokens instead.

data_description.api_key: Only the connection key supplied for the assisted trial.

oauth.name: Advanced OAuth settings
oauth.description: Leave these settings unchanged unless given specific instructions for a dedicated client.

authorize.title: 2. Sign in to ENGIE
authorize.description:
1. [Open the ENGIE website]({authorization_url}) and sign in, including any verification code.
2. Copy the **entire final address from the browser address bar**, even if the final page is blank or shows an error. It must contain `code=` and `state=`: do not copy the verification code or the initial sign-in address.
3. Return to this dialog, paste the address below and press **Submit**.

**Complete this within 10 minutes.** The current ENGIE client does not allow an automatic return to HA. After this step, the session is saved and renewed while ENGIE permits it.

**Does your phone open the ENGIE app?** Start setup again in HA using a desktop browser, where you can copy the final address.

data_description.callback_url: Paste the complete address. It contains a temporary code: do not share it.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to ENGIE again
reauth_confirm.description: ENGIE requires a new sign-in. Your API connection is already configured. Continue using the same ENGIE account as before.

error.invalid_config: Invalid key or settings. Paste only the API key, without spaces; keep the default OAuth settings unless given specific instructions.
error.invalid_auth: The address is invalid, expired, or ENGIE rejected sign-in. Open the link above again and copy the new final address.
error.cannot_connect: The ENGIE service is not responding. Try again later by reopening the link and completing a new sign-in.
error.storage_error: The session could not be saved. Retry saving without signing in again.

abort.wrong_account: The selected account does not match the existing integration.
